purpose: Evaluate whether KSP's read-only simulated aerodynamic wrench API can replay measured original-STS atmospheric kinematics and provide a local Mach/AoA/sideslip/bank grid.

qualification.note: All wrench outputs are counterfactual API simulations. The archived source run explicitly bypassed the shadow gate and cannot qualify the campaign.

provenance.historicalInputPositionVelocity: The archived JSON contains internal canonical XYZ vectors. Before the API call, the probe reverses CLanding/transport/client/session.inc tuple_to_canonical's [x,z,y] axis map to recover raw kRPC body-nonrotating XYZ.
provenance.attitudeReconstruction: Quaternion is solved from each measured air-relative AoA/sideslip, recorded inertial air-velocity direction, and KSP-sign bank. Reconstructed angles are numerically checked before each query.
provenance.machPolicy: Recorded KSP Mach is scaled by the same factor as the measured air-velocity vector at the same historical position and UT.
provenance.angularVelocityPolicy: Zero hypothetical angular velocity to isolate static aerodynamic loads; measured rate reconstruction and aerodynamic damping are excluded.
provenance.surfaceStatePolicy: The loaded checkpoint STS has neutral control surfaces. Historical run-9 surface deflections were not recorded, so simulated wrench is not a matched replay of actual actuator state. RCS state was not recorded per sample.
provenance.noFlightMutation: No setters for UT, pause, position, velocity, rotation, controls, action groups, throttle, SAS, RCS, or save state are called.

measuredCenterComparisons.note: Comparison is diagnostic only: recorded control-surface deflections and per-sample RCS state are unavailable; wrench uses the current checkpoint's neutral surfaces and zero hypothetical angular rate.
